title: Notion update_content returns success while some edits were skipped, listed only in warnings
symptoms: Update page markdown returns 200 but part of the requested text is unchanged
Response includes a warnings array with code no_match or indentation_mismatch
Code that treated any non-error response as full success leaves the page half edited
cause: Since October 16, 2026, when some update_content edits match and others do not, the matching edits are applied and each miss is reported in warnings. The request fails only if no content-changing edit matches. This works for both markdown versions. REST previously skipped misses silently, and the MCP tool failed the whole call.
fix: Check the warnings array after every update_content call and treat any no_match or indentation_mismatch entry as a failure that needs a retry with corrected old_str text. Re-fetch the page markdown to copy exact indentation.
apply: if (res.warnings?.some(w => w.code === 'no_match' || w.code === 'indentation_mismatch')) { /* re-fetch markdown and retry */ }
affected: PATCH /v1/pages/:page_id/markdown and the notion-update-page MCP tool, from October 16, 2026
